passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is the Creator and Ruler of all.
Heaven is the LORD’s throne.
Earth is the LORD’s footstool.
No one can build a house that contains the LORD.
No one can make a place that is the LORD’s resting place.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כִּסְאִ֔י וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֲדֹ֣ם רַגְלָ֑י אֵי־ זֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּבְנוּ־ לִ֔י וְאֵי־ זֶ֥ה מָק֖וֹם מְנוּחָתִֽי׃

passages.text: Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,” declares the LORD. “This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at My word.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD made everything by His own hand.
All things exist because the LORD created them.
The LORD says this.
The LORD looks with favor on a certain person.
This person is humble.
This person has a contrite spirit.
This person trembles at the LORD’s word.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ יָדִ֣י עָשָׂ֔תָה וַיִּהְי֥וּ כָל־ אֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־ זֶ֣ה אַבִּ֔יט אֶל־ עָנִי֙ וּנְכֵה־ ר֔וּחַ וְחָרֵ֖ד עַל־ דְּבָרִֽי׃

passages.text: Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man; whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol. Indeed, they have chosen their own ways and delighted in their abominations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about people who offer sacrifices.
He says, “Whoever kills an ox is like someone who kills a man.
Whoever sacrifices a lamb is like someone who breaks a dog’s neck.
Whoever brings a grain offering is like someone who offers pig’s blood.
Whoever burns incense is like someone who praises an idol.
These people have chosen their own ways.
They take pleasure in things I hate.
They delight in their abominations.”
passages.original: שׁוֹחֵ֨ט הַשּׁ֜וֹר מַכֵּה־ אִ֗ישׁ זוֹבֵ֤חַ הַשֶּׂה֙ עֹ֣רֵֽף כֶּ֔לֶב מַעֲלֵ֤ה מִנְחָה֙ דַּם־ חֲזִ֔יר מַזְכִּ֥יר לְבֹנָ֖ה מְבָ֣רֵֽךְ אָ֑וֶן גַּם־ הֵ֗מָּה בָּֽחֲרוּ֙ בְּדַרְכֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְשִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם נַפְשָׁ֥ם חָפֵֽצָה׃

passages.text: So I will choose their punishment and I will bring terror upon them, because I called and no one answered, I spoke and no one listened. But they did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD says, "I will choose their punishment.
I will bring fear upon them.
I called to them.
No one answered Me.
I spoke to them.
They did not listen to Me.
They did what is evil in My sight.
They chose what I do not desire."
passages.original: גַּם־ אֲנִ֞י אֶבְחַ֣ר בְּתַעֲלֻלֵיהֶ֗ם וּמְגֽוּרֹתָם֙ אָבִ֣יא לָהֶ֔ם יַ֤עַן קָרָ֙אתִי֙ וְאֵ֣ין עוֹנֶ֔ה דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ חָפַ֖צְתִּי בָּחָֽרוּ׃ס

passages.text: You who tremble at His word, hear the word of the LORD: “Your brothers who hate you and exclude you because of My name have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified that we may see your joy!’ But they will be put to shame.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to those who tremble at His word.
You fear and respect God's word.
Listen to the word of the LORD.
Your own brothers hate you.
They exclude you because you follow God's name.
They say, “Let the LORD be glorified.
We want to see your joy.”
But God will put them to shame.
passages.original: שִׁמְעוּ֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה הַחֲרֵדִ֖ים אֶל־ דְּבָר֑וֹ אָמְרוּ֩ אֲחֵיכֶ֨ם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶ֜ם מְנַדֵּיכֶ֗ם לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ יִכְבַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה וְנִרְאֶ֥ה בְשִׂמְחַתְכֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם יֵבֹֽשׁוּ׃

passages.text: Hear the uproar from the city; listen to the voice from the temple! It is the voice of the LORD, repaying His enemies what they deserve!
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with power and authority.
He is present in Jerusalem.
There is a loud noise coming from the city.
There is a sound coming from the temple.
This is the voice of the LORD.
The LORD is repaying His enemies.
He gives them what they deserve.
passages.original: ק֤וֹל שָׁאוֹן֙ מֵעִ֔יר ק֖וֹל מֵֽהֵיכָ֑ל ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁלֵּ֥ם גְּמ֖וּל לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃

passages.text: “Before she was in labor, she gave birth; before she was in pain, she delivered a boy.
passages.sermon: A woman gave birth before she went into labor.\r\nShe delivered a boy before she felt any pain.
passages.original: בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּחִ֖יל יָלָ֑דָה בְּטֶ֨רֶם יָב֥וֹא חֵ֛בֶל לָ֖הּ וְהִמְלִ֥יטָה זָכָֽר׃

passages.text: Who has heard of such as this? Who has seen such things? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be delivered in an instant? Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
passages.sermon:
God speaks through the prophet Isaiah.
God describes a miracle about Zion, which is Jerusalem.
No one has heard of anything like this before.
No one has seen anything like this before.
No one has seen a country born in a single day.
No one has seen a nation delivered all at once.
But Zion went into labor.
Zion gave birth to her children immediately.
passages.original: מִֽי־ שָׁמַ֣ע כָּזֹ֗את מִ֤י רָאָה֙ כָּאֵ֔לֶּה הֲי֤וּחַל אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּי֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד אִם־ יִוָּ֥לֵֽד גּ֖וֹי פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כִּֽי־ חָ֛לָה גַּם־ יָלְדָ֥ה צִיּ֖וֹן אֶת־ בָּנֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Shall I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it?” says the LORD. “Or will I who deliver close the womb?” says your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is the one who brings a baby to the point of birth.
The LORD asks, “Shall I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it?”
Your God is the one who delivers.
Your God asks, “Will I, who deliver, close the womb?”
passages.original: הַאֲנִ֥י אַשְׁבִּ֛יר וְלֹ֥א אוֹלִ֖יד יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־ אֲנִ֧י הַמּוֹלִ֛יד וְעָצַ֖רְתִּי אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃ס

passages.text: Be glad for Jerusalem and rejoice over her, all who love her. Rejoice greatly with her, all who mourn over her, so that you may nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you may drink deeply and delight yourselves in her glorious abundance.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is the city of God.
God calls people to be glad for Jerusalem.
All who love Jerusalem must rejoice over her.
All who mourn for Jerusalem must rejoice greatly with her.
God gives comfort through Jerusalem.
You will nurse at her comforting breasts.
You will be satisfied by her comfort.
You will drink deeply from her glorious abundance.
You will delight in all the blessings she gives.
passages.original: שִׂמְח֧וּ אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְגִ֥ילוּ בָ֖הּ כָּל־ אֹהֲבֶ֑יהָ שִׂ֤ישׂוּ אִתָּהּ֙ מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ כָּל־ הַמִּֽתְאַבְּלִ֖ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃ לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽינְקוּ֙ וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֔ם מִשֹּׁ֖ד תַּנְחֻמֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֧עַן תָּמֹ֛צּוּ וְהִתְעַנַּגְתֶּ֖ם מִזִּ֥יז כְּבוֹדָֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD says: “I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flowing stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm, and bounced upon her knees.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD promises to bless Jerusalem.
The LORD says, “I will give peace to Jerusalem.
My peace will flow to her like a river.
I will bring the wealth of nations to her.
This wealth will come like a strong, flowing stream.
You will nurse from her.
You will be carried on her arm.
You will be bounced on her knees.”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹטֶֽה־ אֵ֠לֶיהָ כְּנָהָ֨ר שָׁל֜וֹם וּכְנַ֧חַל שׁוֹטֵ֛ף כְּב֥וֹד גּוֹיִ֖ם וִֽינַקְתֶּ֑ם עַל־ צַד֙ תִּנָּשֵׂ֔אוּ וְעַל־ בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תְּשָׁעֳשָֽׁעוּ׃

passages.text: As a mother comforts her son, so will I comfort you, and you will be consoled over Jerusalem.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises comfort.
A mother comforts her son.
God will comfort you in the same way.
God will comfort you in Jerusalem.
You will find consolation in Jerusalem.
passages.original: כְּאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִמּ֖וֹ תְּנַחֲמֶ֑נּוּ כֵּ֤ן אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֲנַ֣חֶמְכֶ֔ם וּבִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תְּנֻחָֽמוּ׃

passages.text: When you see, you will rejoice, and you will flourish like grass; then the hand of the LORD will be revealed to His servants, but His wrath will be shown to His enemies.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act with power.
You will see what the LORD does.
Your heart will rejoice.
You will feel gladness inside.
Your bodies will grow strong.
You will flourish like green grass.
The LORD will show His hand to His servants.
The LORD will reveal His power to those who serve Him.
The LORD will show His anger to His enemies.
The LORD will punish those who oppose Him.
passages.original: וּרְאִיתֶם֙ וְשָׂ֣שׂ לִבְּכֶ֔ם וְעַצְמוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם כַּדֶּ֣שֶׁא תִפְרַ֑חְנָה וְנוֹדְעָ֤ה יַד־ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֔יו וְזָעַ֖ם אֶת־ אֹיְבָֽיו׃

passages.text: For behold, the LORD will come with fire— His chariots are like a whirlwind— to execute His anger with fury and His rebuke with flames of fire.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is coming.
He will come with fire.
His chariots will move like a whirlwind.
He will show His anger with great fury.
He will rebuke with flames of fire.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בָּאֵ֣שׁ יָב֔וֹא וְכַסּוּפָ֖ה מַרְכְּבֹתָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֤יב בְּחֵמָה֙ אַפּ֔וֹ וְגַעֲרָת֖וֹ בְּלַהֲבֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: For by fire and by His sword, the LORD will execute judgment on all flesh, and many will be slain by the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD judges all people.
The LORD uses fire to judge.
The LORD uses His sword to judge.
The LORD judges every living person.
Many people will die by the hand of the LORD.
passages.original: כִּ֤י בָאֵשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה נִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחַרְבּ֖וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר וְרַבּ֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Those who consecrate and purify themselves to enter the groves—to follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine and vermin and rats—will perish together,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD sees people who try to make themselves holy and clean.
These people go into gardens.
They follow a leader in the center.
They eat the flesh of pigs.
They eat unclean things.
They eat rats.
The LORD says these people will all perish together.
passages.original: הַמִּתְקַדְּשִׁ֨ים וְהַמִּֽטַּהֲרִ֜ים אֶל־ הַגַּנּ֗וֹת אַחַ֤ר אֶחָד בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ אֹֽכְלֵי֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַחֲזִ֔יר וְהַשֶּׁ֖קֶץ וְהָעַכְבָּ֑ר יַחְדָּ֥ו יָסֻ֖פוּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “And I, knowing their deeds and thoughts, am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see My glory.
passages.sermon:
The LORD knows the deeds of all people.
The LORD knows the thoughts of all people.
The LORD will come.
The LORD will gather all nations.
The LORD will gather all languages.
All people will come to the LORD.
All people will see the glory of the LORD.
passages.original: וְאָנֹכִ֗י מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ וּמַחְשְׁבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם בָּאָ֕ה לְקַבֵּ֥ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְהַלְּשֹׁנ֑וֹת וּבָ֖אוּ וְרָא֥וּ אֶת־ כְּבוֹדִֽי׃

passages.text: I will establish a sign among them, and I will send survivors from among them to the nations—to Tarshish, Put, and the archers of Lud; to Tubal, Javan, and the islands far away who have not heard of My fame or seen My glory. So they will proclaim My glory among the nations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD knows the deeds and thoughts of the people.
The LORD will act.
The LORD will establish a sign among the people.
The LORD will choose survivors from among them.
The LORD will send these survivors to the nations.
The LORD will send them to Tarshish.
The LORD will send them to Put.
The LORD will send them to Lud, whose people are archers.
The LORD will send them to Tubal.
The LORD will send them to Javan.
The LORD will send them to the distant islands.
These distant islands have not heard of the LORD’s fame.
These distant islands have not seen the LORD’s glory.
The survivors will proclaim the LORD’s glory among the nations.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י בָהֶ֜ם א֗וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י מֵהֶ֣ם׀ פְּ֠לֵיטִים אֶֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֞ם תַּרְשִׁ֨ישׁ פּ֥וּל וְל֛וּד מֹ֥שְׁכֵי קֶ֖שֶׁת תֻּבַ֣ל וְיָוָ֑ן הָאִיִּ֣ים הָרְחֹקִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ שָׁמְע֤וּ אֶת־ שִׁמְעִי֙ וְלֹא־ רָא֣וּ אֶת־ כְּבוֹדִ֔י וְהִגִּ֥ידוּ אֶת־ כְּבוֹדִ֖י בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations as a gift to the LORD on horses and chariots and wagons, on mules and camels, to My holy mountain Jerusalem,” says the LORD, “just as the Israelites bring an offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says He will gather people from all nations.
They will bring all your brothers from every nation.
They will bring them as a gift to the LORD.
They will use horses.
They will use chariots.
They will use wagons.
They will use mules.
They will use camels.
They will bring them to My holy mountain in Jerusalem.
The LORD says this.
They will do this just as the Israelites bring an offering.
The Israelites bring their offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם׀ מִנְחָ֣ה׀ לַֽיהוָ֡ה בַּסּוּסִ֡ים וּ֠בָרֶכֶב וּבַצַּבִּ֨ים וּבַפְּרָדִ֜ים וּבַכִּרְכָּר֗וֹת עַ֣ל הַ֥ר קָדְשִׁ֛י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבִיאוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֛ה בִּכְלִ֥י טָה֖וֹר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “And I will select some of them as priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will choose some people from among the survivors.
The LORD will make these people priests.
The LORD will make these people Levites.
passages.original: וְגַם־ מֵהֶ֥ם אֶקַּ֛ח לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים לַלְוִיִּ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “For just as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, will endure before Me,” declares the LORD, “so your descendants and your name will endure.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will make new heavens.
The LORD will make a new earth.
These new heavens and new earth will last before the LORD.
The LORD promises this.
In the same way, your descendants will last.
Your name will last.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם הַ֠חֳדָשִׁים וְהָאָ֨רֶץ הַחֲדָשָׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה עֹמְדִ֥ים לְפָנַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כֵּ֛ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד זַרְעֲכֶ֖ם וְשִׁמְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come to worship before Me,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says He will act.
All people will come before the LORD.
They will come to worship the LORD.
They will come every month at the New Moon.
They will come every week on the Sabbath.
This will happen again and again.
All people will worship the LORD.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה מִֽדֵּי־ חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בְּחָדְשׁ֔וֹ וּמִדֵּ֥י שַׁבָּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ יָב֧וֹא כָל־ בָּשָׂ֛ר לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֥ת לְפָנַ֖י אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God is the LORD.
God describes what will happen in the future.
People will go out.
They will see dead bodies.
These bodies belong to men who rebelled against God.
The worm that eats these bodies will not die.
The fire that burns these bodies will not go out.
All people will see this.
These dead bodies will be a horror to everyone.
passages.original: וְיָצְא֣וּ וְרָא֔וּ בְּפִגְרֵי֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַפֹּשְׁעִ֖ים בִּ֑י כִּ֣י תוֹלַעְתָּ֞ם לֹ֣א תָמ֗וּת וְאִשָּׁם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ דֵרָא֖וֹן לְכָל־ בָּשָֽׂר׃
